sources.entry: Clearview - Tabbed style e-book reader for PDF, EPUB (DRM free), CHM, and MOBI. [![App Store][app-store Icon]](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/clearview/id557090104?platform=mac)

summary.name: Clearview X
summary.one_liner: Clearview X is a tabbed e-book reader for PDF, EPUB, CHM, MOBI, AZW, FB2 and comic book files, with annotations, bookmarks and library management.
use_cases: Reading PDF, EPUB, MOBI or CHM books in one app
Reading comic books in CBR or CBZ format
Annotating and highlighting e-books across devices
Organizing an ebook library using Finder folders
Reading EPUB or MOBI in continuous scroll like a PDF
summary.what_it_does: Clearview X reads PDF, EPUB, CHM, MOBI, AZW, FB2 and comic book (CBR, CBZ) files in page-flip or continuous scrolling modes, as single or two-column layouts. Users can import folders dragged from Finder onto a library shelf, organize books into collections, and search by user, title or content. Readers can adjust color themes (Normal, Sepia, Night time), text size, line height and font family, and view page thumbnails. Annotations and bookmarks work on all formats, and are stored in the library database rather than in the original book files, with notes viewable and exportable from the shelf.
notable: Continuous scrolling mode for EPUB, MOBI and CHM like PDF
Annotations stored in library database, not original files
PDF annotation tools including arrows, shapes and free draw
caveats: Pricing not stated on the page
Annotation tools differ by format; EPUB, MOBI and CHM support fewer annotation types than PDF
